misses.counterfactual_theory: A frozen, timestamped forecast specification linked to its eligible evidence cutoff and matured outcome would make it possible to assess forecast accuracy and timing. The supplied records do not establish that such evidence would have changed any decision or prevented a demonstrated miss.
misses.decision_reference: The supplied settlement records contain target-time BTC/ETH prices but no linked prior forecast specification, issuance time, or eligible evidence cutoff. See the settlement records and EG-FORECAST-OUTCOMES / EG-UNCLASSIFIED-EVIDENCE registry entries.
misses.decision_relevance: Without forecast-to-outcome lineage, these target-time prices cannot establish what was forecast beforehand or whether a decision failed.
misses.miss_description: Auditability gap only: confirmed target-time prices are supplied, but there is no linked, cutoff-qualified prior forecast against which to establish a forecast or decision failure. This discovery episode does not validate the proposed metric.
misses.missing_history_problem: The settlement target timestamps are adjudication times, not decision or source-observation timestamps. Frozen forecast specifications, issuance and evidence-cutoff timestamps, and linked matured outcomes are absent.
misses.outcome_reference: FORECAST_SETTLEMENT_EVIDENCE records for the listed EXP-FC forecasts, including EXP-FC-fe4f390da43656d3bc36; these provide confirmed target-time mark prices only.
misses.proposed_metric_name: Frozen forecast specification, issuance/evidence-cutoff, and linked matured-outcome record
